name: Crippling Touch (Combat)
body:
You have learned to use the arcane power of your touch to hinder your opponents.

Prerequisite: Magus Arcana (pool strike) class ability, CL 10

Benefit: An opponent damaged by your pool strike ability also takes 2 points of Strength damage for every 3 arcane pool points spent using that ability.
